meaning:
Sirion = "breastplate"
one of the names of Mount Hermon this one used by the Sidonians
Another spelling of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)

elsewhere.note: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)
He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.
